title: 行为诱导的镜像-近端时序差分学习加速离策略预测
summary: 提出STHTD-MP方法，用行为策略Bellman矩阵的对称部分替代协方差度量，在原始-对偶鞍点公式中引入行为诱导几何，实现更快的离策略预测收敛。提供收敛性分析和数值验证。
summary_en: Proposes STHTD-MP, replacing the covariance metric with the symmetric part of the behavior-policy Bellman matrix in the primal-dual saddle-point formulation, enabling faster off-policy prediction convergence. Provides convergence analysis and numerical validation.
